content: Eesawenne Iya Yeletetha
Edoome geetetiya Eesawe yeletethay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa;
Eesawey Kanaane biitta macca naytape baw machota ekis. Entika Hite addiya Eloona na7iw Ado, Hiwe addiya Xiba7oona na7ay Ani yelida Oholbaamonne
Isma7eela na7iw, Nebayoota michiw Basemaato.
Ada Eesawes Elfaaza yelasu. Basemaata Ragu7eela yelasu.
Oholbaama Ye7usa, Ya7ilamanne Qore yelasu. Kanaane biittan Eesawes yeletida adde nayti haysata.
Eesawey ba macheta, ba adde naytanne macca nayta, ba soo asa ubbaa, ba miizanne ba hara mehe ubbaa Kanaane biittan haaridaba ubbaa ekidi ba isha Yayqoobape haakidi hara biitta bis.
Enta shaloy darida gisho, enti issife daanaw danda7ibookona. Enta mehey darida gisho, enti de7iya biittay enta nam7aas gidonna ixis.
Yaanin, Edoome geetetiya Eesawey derey dariya Sayre biittan de7is.
Derey dariya Sayre biittan de7ida Edoometa mayza Eesawe yeletethay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa;
Eesawe adde nayta sunthay, Eesawe mache Adi na7aa Elfaazanne Eesawe mache Basemaati na7a Ragu7eela.
Elfaaza nayti Temaana, Omaara, Xafa, Ga7itamanne Qeneza.
Qassi Timnaa7a Eesawe na7a Elfaazas aylle. Iya Elfaazas Amaaleqa yelasu. Haysati Eesawe mache Adi na7aa nayta.
Ragu7eela adde nayti Nahaata, Zara, Shamanne Miiza. Haysati Eesawe mache Basemaati na7a nayta.
Xiba7oona na7ay Ani yelida Oholbaama adde nayti haysata; Entika Ye7usa, Ya7ilamanne Qore.
Eesawe yeleta halaqati haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysata; Eesawes bayra na7a Elfaaza adde nayti, halaqa gididaysati Temaana, Omaara, Xafa, Qanaza,
Qore, Ga7itamanne Amaaleqa; Edoome biittan Elfaazi yelida halaqati haysata; hessati ubbay Adi na7aa nayta.
Eesawe na7a Ragu7eela adde nayti, halaqa gididaysati Nahaata, Zaraha, Shamanne Miiza; Edoome biittan Ragu7eeli yelida halaqati haysata; enti Eesawe mache Basemaati na7a nayta.
Eesawe mache Oholbaami adde nayti, halaqa gididaysati Ye7usa, Ya7ilamanne Qore; enti Ana na7e, Eesawe mache Oholbaamipe yeletida halaqata.
Edoome geetetiya Eesawe adde nayti haysata; enta halaqatika haysata.
Sayrenne Yeletetha
Edoome biittan de7iya Hoora Sayre adde nayti haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysata; hessatika Loxaana, Shobaala, Xiba7oona, Ana,
Disoona, Exeranne Disaana; hessati, Edoome biittan de7iya Sayre adde nayti, Hoorata halaqata.
Loxaana adde nayti Hooranne Hemaama; Loxaana michiya Timnaa7o.
Sobaala adde nayti Aliwa, Manahoota, Ebaala, Sifanne Onaama.
Xiba7oona adde nayti Ayanne Ana; haysi Ani mela biittan ba aawa Xiba7oona hareta heemmishe bilbo haatha pultuwa demmidaysa.
Ana na7ay Disoona; na7iya qassi Oholbaamo.
Disoona adde nayti Hemdaana, Esbaana, Yitraananne Kaarana.
Exera adde nayti Bilihaana, Zawananne Aqana.
Disaana adde nayti Uxanne Arana.
Hoorata halaqati haysata; Loxaana, Shobaala, Xiba7oona, Ana,
Disoona, Exeranne Disaana. Haysati Sayre biittan banta yaran yaran shaaketida Hoorata halaqata.
Edoome Ayseysata
Isra7eelen Kawoy kawotanaape kase Edoome biittan kawotida kawoti haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysata.
Bi7oora na7ay Balaaqi Edoomen kawotis; iya katamaa sunthay Dinaaba geetetees.
Balaaqi hayqin, Baasora addey Zaara na7ay Yobaabi iya bessan kawotis.
Yobaabi hayqin, Temaana addey Husami kawotis.
Husami hayqin, Badada na7ay Hadaadi, Midiyaameta Moo7abe biittan xoonidaysi kawotis; iya katamaa sunthay Awiita geetetis.
Hadaadi hayqin, Masreeqa addey Samili kawotis.
Samili hayqin, shaafa matan de7iya Rehoboota addey Saa7uli kawotis.
Saa7uli hayqin, Akboora na7ay Ba7al-Hanani kawotis.
Akboora na7a Ba7al-Hanani hayqin, Hadaadi kawotis; iya katamaa sunthay Paa7u geetetees; iya machiya Mezahaaba na7iya Maxireeda yelida Mahexabeelo geetetawusu.
Eesawe yeleta halaqati banta yaran yaran, banta bessan bessan banta sunthan sunthan haysata; Timina, Aliwa, Yeteta,
Oholbaama, Ela, Pinoona,
Qanaza, Temaana, Mibsaara,
Magdelanne Irama. Haysati banta aysiya biittan, banta de7iyasuwan de7iyasuwan Edoome halaqata. Haysi Eesawey, Edoometa aawa.
